```{r, include=FALSE}
#load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(corrplot)
library(broom)
```

# Read in climate and field data
```{r, include=FALSE}
field_climate_08_23_inc <- read.csv("field_climate_08_23_w18_21_growth_NSavgs.csv", row.names=1, na.strings="NA")%>%
  mutate(SHM_mult_dist = (-1*(1 - (SHM/Site_SHM)))*100)%>% #calculate the SHM transfer distance in terms of percent 
  mutate(SHM_mult_dist = round(SHM_mult_dist, digits=3))%>%
  mutate(MAT_dist_sq = MAT_dist^2,
         MAP_dist_sq = MAP_dist^2,
         MCMT_dist_sq = MCMT_dist^2,
         TD_dist_sq = TD_dist^2,
         MSP_dist_sq = MSP_dist^2,
         MWMT_dist_sq = MWMT_dist^2,
         CMD_dist_sq = CMD_dist^2,
         CMI_dist_sq = CMI_dist^2,
         SHM_mult_dist_sq = SHM_mult_dist^2) %>%
  mutate(LD = as.factor(if_else(TS == 1, "L",
                      if_else(TS == 2, "L",
                              if_else(TS == 3, "L","D")))))
field_climate_08_23_inc$Unique_ID <- seq_len(nrow(field_climate_08_23_inc))

field_climate_08_23_inc$MCMT_dist_std <- (field_climate_08_23_inc$MCMT_dist - mean(field_climate_08_23_inc$MCMT_dist))/(2*sd(field_climate_08_23_inc$MCMT_dist))
field_climate_08_23_inc$MWMT_dist_std <- (field_climate_08_23_inc$MWMT_dist - mean(field_climate_08_23_inc$MWMT_dist))/(2*sd(field_climate_08_23_inc$MWMT_dist))
field_climate_08_23_inc$MSP_dist_std <- (field_climate_08_23_inc$MSP_dist - mean(field_climate_08_23_inc$MSP_dist))/(2*sd(field_climate_08_23_inc$MSP_dist))
field_climate_08_23_inc$TD_dist_std <- (field_climate_08_23_inc$TD_dist - mean(field_climate_08_23_inc$TD_dist))/(2*sd(field_climate_08_23_inc$TD_dist))
field_climate_08_23_inc$SHM_dist_std <- (field_climate_08_23_inc$SHM_dist - mean(field_climate_08_23_inc$SHM_dist))/(2*sd(field_climate_08_23_inc$SHM_dist))
field_climate_08_23_inc$MAT_dist_std <- (field_climate_08_23_inc$MAT_dist - mean(field_climate_08_23_inc$MAT_dist))/(2*sd(field_climate_08_23_inc$MAT_dist))

live_trees <- field_climate_08_23_inc %>% filter(TS==1|TS==2|TS==3) #7881 live trees assessed

dead_trees <- field_climate_08_23_inc %>%filter(LD=='D') %>%dplyr::select("Unique_ID","LD")
# 302 dead trees assessed for sunken bole, pitching on bole, galls
```

# Chlorosis
Percentiles of interest
0 - 0
0.5x - 83
1x - 165
2x - 331
3x - 496

## Sim 1
```{r,echo=FALSE}
set.seed(25)
#0x - 0 trees
chlorrand_0 <- dead_trees[sample(nrow(dead_trees), size=0), ] %>% mutate(Chlor_0 = 1)

#0.5x - 83 trees
chlorrand_05 <- dead_trees[sample(nrow(dead_trees), size=83), ] %>% mutate(Chor_05 = 1)

#1x - 165 trees
chlorrand_1 <- dead_trees[sample(nrow(dead_trees), size=165), ] %>% mutate(Chlor_1 = 1)

#2x - 331 trees
chlorrand_2 <- dead_trees[sample(nrow(dead_trees), size=331), ] %>% mutate(Chlor_2 = 1)

#3x - 496 trees
chlorrand_3 <- dead_trees[sample(nrow(dead_trees), size=496), ] %>% mutate(Chlor_3 = 1)


chlor_sensDD_join <- left_join(dead_trees,chlorrand_0, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) %>%
  left_join(.,chlorrand_05, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) %>%
  left_join(.,chlorrand_1, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) %>%
  left_join(.,chlorrand_2, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) %>%
  left_join(.,chlorrand_3, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) 

chlor_sensDD_repl <- chlor_sensDD_join %>%
  mutate(chlorrand_0 = if_else(is.na(Chlor_0),0, Chlor_0))%>%
  mutate(chlorrand_05 = if_else(is.na(Chor_05),0, Chor_05))%>%
  mutate(chlorrand_1 = if_else(is.na(Chlor_1),0, Chlor_1))%>%
  mutate(chlorrand_2 = if_else(is.na(Chlor_2),0, Chlor_2))%>%
  mutate(chlorrand_3 = if_else(is.na(Chlor_3),0, Chlor_3))


tmp_chlor_wDD_sims <- left_join(field_climate_08_23_inc,chlor_sensDD_repl, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) %>%
  mutate(across(c(chlorrand_0:chlorrand_3), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), CC_yellow, .)))
```

### Standardized variables
```{r, echo=FALSE}
tmp_chlor_wDD_sims$TD_dist_std <- (tmp_chlor_wDD_sims$TD_dist - mean(tmp_chlor_wDD_sims$TD_dist))/(2*sd(tmp_chlor_wDD_sims$TD_dist))
tmp_chlor_wDD_sims$MCMT_dist_std <- (tmp_chlor_wDD_sims$MCMT_dist - mean(tmp_chlor_wDD_sims$MCMT_dist))/(2*sd(tmp_chlor_wDD_sims$MCMT_dist))
tmp_chlor_wDD_sims$MSP_dist_std <- (tmp_chlor_wDD_sims$MSP_dist - mean(tmp_chlor_wDD_sims$MSP_dist))/(2*sd(tmp_chlor_wDD_sims$MSP_dist))
```

### Models
```{r, echo=FALSE}
modChlor.OG <- glmmTMB(CC_yellow ~ MCMT_dist_std +  I(MCMT_dist_std^2) + MSP_dist_std + I(MSP_dist_std^2) + TD_dist_std + I(TD_dist_std^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = field_climate_08_23_inc, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

modChlor1.DD0x <- glmmTMB(chlorrand_0 ~ MCMT_dist_std +  I(MCMT_dist_std^2) + MSP_dist_std + I(MSP_dist_std^2) + TD_dist_std + I(TD_dist_std^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = tmp_chlor_wDD_sims, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

modChlor.DD0xboth <- glmmTMB(chlorrand_0 ~ MCMT_dist +  I(MCMT_dist^2) + MSP_dist + I(MSP_dist^2) + TD_dist + I(TD_dist^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = tmp_chlor_wDD_sims, family = binomial(link = "logit"))


modChlor1.DD05x <- glmmTMB(chlorrand_05 ~ MCMT_dist_std +  I(MCMT_dist_std^2) + MSP_dist_std + I(MSP_dist_std^2) + TD_dist_std + I(TD_dist_std^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = tmp_chlor_wDD_sims, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

modChlor1.DD1x <- glmmTMB(chlorrand_1 ~ MCMT_dist_std +  I(MCMT_dist_std^2) + MSP_dist_std + I(MSP_dist_std^2) + TD_dist_std + I(TD_dist_std^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = tmp_chlor_wDD_sims, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

modChlor.DD1xhigh <- glmmTMB(chlorrand_1 ~ MCMT_dist +  I(MCMT_dist^2) + MSP_dist + I(MSP_dist^2) + TD_dist + I(TD_dist^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = tmp_chlor_wDD_sims, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

modChlor1.DD2x <- glmmTMB(chlorrand_2 ~ MCMT_dist_std +  I(MCMT_dist_std^2) + MSP_dist_std + I(MSP_dist_std^2) + TD_dist_std + I(TD_dist_std^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = tmp_chlor_wDD_sims, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

modChlor1.DD3x <- glmmTMB(chlorrand_3 ~ MCMT_dist_std +  I(MCMT_dist_std^2) + MSP_dist_std + I(MSP_dist_std^2) + TD_dist_std + I(TD_dist_std^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = tmp_chlor_wDD_sims, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

modChlor.DD3xlow <- glmmTMB(chlorrand_3 ~ MCMT_dist +  I(MCMT_dist^2) + MSP_dist + I(MSP_dist^2) + TD_dist + I(TD_dist^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = tmp_chlor_wDD_sims, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
```

### Tidy dataframes
```{r,echo=FALSE}
modChlorOG_df<-tidy(modChlor.OG, conf.int = TRUE, effects = "fixed")
modChlorOG_df$model <- "OG"
modChlorOG_df$multiplier <- "Original model"

sim1Chlor0x_df<-tidy(modChlor1.DD0x, conf.int = TRUE, effects = "fixed")
sim1Chlor0x_df$model <- "Sim 1"
sim1Chlor0x_df$multiplier <- "0"

sim1Chlor05x_df<-tidy(modChlor1.DD05x, conf.int = TRUE, effects = "fixed")
sim1Chlor05x_df$model <- "Sim 1"
sim1Chlor05x_df$multiplier <- "0.5x"

sim1Chlor1x_df<-tidy(modChlor1.DD1x, conf.int = TRUE, effects = "fixed")
sim1Chlor1x_df$model <- "Sim 1"
sim1Chlor1x_df$multiplier <- "1x"

sim1Chlor2x_df<-tidy(modChlor1.DD2x, conf.int = TRUE, effects = "fixed")
sim1Chlor2x_df$model <- "Sim 1"
sim1Chlor2x_df$multiplier <- "2x"

sim1Chlor3x_df<-tidy(modChlor1.DD3x, conf.int = TRUE, effects = "fixed")
sim1Chlor3x_df$model <- "Sim 1"
sim1Chlor3x_df$multiplier <- "3x"
```

## Coefficient plots
```{r,echo=FALSE}
Chlorcoefs_ALL <- read.csv("ChlorosisProb_sim_coefs.csv")%>% mutate(term = fct_relevel(term, "(Intercept)", "I(TD_dist_std^2)","TD_dist_std","I(MSP_dist_std^2)","MSP_dist_std","I(MCMT_dist_std^2)","MCMT_dist_std")) %>%
  mutate(multiplier = fct_relevel(multiplier, "0","0.5x","1x","2x","3x", "Original model")) 


pal5_t <- turbo(5, alpha=1, begin=0.2, end=1)
pal6 <- c("#3E9BFEFF", "#46F884FF", "#E1DD37FF", "#F05B12FF", "#7A0403FF","gray")

(coefchlor<- Chlorcoefs_ALL %>% filter(term !="(Intercept)") %>% 
              ggplot(aes(estimate, term, color=multiplier, xmin=conf.low,xmax = conf.high)) + 
    theme_classic()+
 
    geom_errorbar(position = position_dodge2(.9, padding = .1, reverse=TRUE), stat="identity")+
      geom_point(aes(color=multiplier),
  fill="black",alpha=0.3,pch=21, position = position_dodge2(.9, padding = .1, reverse=TRUE), stat="identity")  +
   scale_color_manual("Multiplier",values=pal6,labels = c('0x', '0.5x', '1x','2x','3x',"Original model"))+
    geom_vline(xintercept=0,lty=2)+
  labs(x = "Standardized coefficient",y =NULL, title="Probability of chlorosis")+
   scale_y_discrete(labels = c(expression(paste("TD"^"2")),"TD",expression(paste("MSP"^"2")),"MSP",expression(paste("MCMT"^"2")),"MCMT"))+
  theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=10),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=10),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=11),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=11)))
ggsave(coefchlor, file="SSMT_FH_Chlor_Sensitivity_coefs_title.png", dpi=600, height=6, width=6)
```
